remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained 4-bedroom Raised Ranch, ideally located within a short walk to the town center and a short distance to the train station. This home is connected to public water and sewer-no septic system-providing convenience and peace of mind. The sunlit upper level features an open-concept living and formal dining area, perfect for entertaining. The spacious kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, rich cabinetry, and updated appliances, and opens to a stylish cable rail deck for outdoor enjoyment. The primary bedroom includes a newly renovated bathroom with modern finishes, and all closets are outfitted with the Elfa closet system. The lower level offers a third full bathroom, a large laundry room with abundant storage, and a generous recreational area that includes a custom-built California Closet home office. A fourth bedroom with built-in bookshelves offers flexible use as a guest room, private office, or expanded dressing room. This home is a true gem offering comfort, style, and generous living space across two finished levels-all within close proximity to town amenities and commuter transportation.
